# Yathin Looops

> Free apps by Yathin Pedamallu, all in one place. No paid services, no sign-up walls.

## Apps

- [Yathin AI](https://yathinlooops.pages.dev/yathinai/): free AI chat, coding, physics and 3D, with no key and no download
- [Magic Cursor](https://yathinlooops.pages.dev/magiccursor/): fun animated cursors for Windows
- [ClassView](https://yathinlooops.pages.dev/classview/): classroom Chromebook monitor demo for teachers
- [Fridge Chef](https://yathinlooops.pages.dev/fridgechef/): photo of your fridge to recipes
- [Plant Doc](https://yathinlooops.pages.dev/plantdoc/): plant photo health check
- [What to Wear](https://yathinlooops.pages.dev/whattowear/): outfit ideas from the weather
- [Finko](https://yathinlooops.pages.dev/finko/): virtual robot pet

## More

- [Home](https://yathinlooops.pages.dev/): every app in one place
- [Sitemap](https://yathinlooops.pages.dev/sitemap.xml)
